youtube_description:
Once work moves across time, correctness depends on retries, compensation, dead letter queues, and control over side effects. The lecture covers exponential backoff, rollback-style compensation, DLQs, circuit breakers, and asynchronous boundaries.

This CS 5254 Week 13 lecture explores retries, compensation, and dead letter queues and their impact on concurrent system design.
